Roman dates count inclusively, so subtract one less than the stated number from the reference day.

1. III Kal. Mart. → 3 days before Mar 1 inclusive → Feb 27 → 27.02  
2. pridie Id. Oct. → day before Oct 15 → Oct 14 → 14.10  
3. VI Non. Mai. → 6 days before May 7 inclusive → May 2 → 02.05  
4. XVII Kal. Ian. → 17 days before Jan 1 inclusive → Dec 16 → 16.12  
5. VIII Id. Iul. → 8 days before Jul 15 inclusive → Jul 8 → 08.07  
6. XI Kal. Iun. → 11 days before Jun 1 inclusive → May 22 → 22.05  

ANSWER: 27.02, 14.10, 02.05, 16.12, 08.07, 22.05
